name: Netflix Catalog
tagline: A real slice of the Netflix catalog from Kaggle — titles, genres, countries and credits.
description: Normalised from the Kaggle "Netflix Movies and TV Shows" dataset (deterministic ~1/13 sample). Movies have duration_minutes, TV shows have seasons. Genres, countries and credits are many-to-many link tables.
